unresolved_corporate_inputs: Legal valuation perimeter and treatment of the announced North American gold-assets transaction
Production and cost are current Barrick actuals only for 2026Q1-Q2; 2026Q3-2030 remain Team 4 forecasts
The USD 4,417/oz price anchor is Barrick's Q2 average realized price, not a point-in-time spot quote or a physical-price forecast
GLD-to-gold, gold-to-realized-price and Q-to-P/scenario bridges are not validated
Cost of Sales includes depreciation; component margin is not reconciled audited EBITDA, EBIT, NOPAT or FCFF
Debt, cash, minority interests, non-operating assets and other claims are explicit zero placeholders
Diluted shares are an unreconciled proxy inferred from the LSE market-cap/price snapshot
WACC, terminal growth, ROIC and tax remain methodological assumptions, not filing-calibrated Barrick inputs
Finite reserve life and mine-level closure/reclamation policy are not represented
